recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining current-spec contradiction without reopening the later WG decision that accession number guidance belongs under ImagingStudy.basedOn rather than ImagingStudy.identifier.
issue_request: FHIR-22118 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked II to separate accession number from ImagingStudy.identifier, store it as an ImagingStudy.basedOn Reference.identifier with identifier.type ACSN, and update mapping, examples, narrative, and search text.
initial_application: Commit b650c1dd54d447dcbc8aa5fbbab7cacf81972898 applied the main R5 changes: XR example accession moved from identifier to basedOn, notes/search/StructureDefinition text were updated, and accession was removed from the DICOM identifier mapping. The remaining gap was the active StructureDefinition RIM mapping for ImagingStudy.identifier, which still included an ACSN inbound relationship.
additional_context: Later Applied issues changed and clarified the same policy. FHIR-48644 temporarily moved accession back to ImagingStudy.identifier, FHIR-49675 reversed that direction after the identifier-scope discussion and restored accession to ImagingStudy.basedOn, and FHIR-56033 removed a remaining accession reference from ImagingStudy.identifier comments. ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, making the StructureDefinition a current build input.
reconciliation: Changed source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml so ImagingStudy.identifier RIM mapping is .id only. Existing basedOn requirements, the Accession Number note, based-on search parameter, XR example, and DICOM basedOn mapping were left unchanged because they already match the final Jira family direction.
source_changes: source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml: changed the ImagingStudy.identifier RIM mapping from '.id and .inboundRelationship[typeCode=COMP].source[classCode=ACSN, moodCode=EVN].id' to '.id'.
